name: largefile-monorepo
description: A monorepo project with Vue3 frontend and Express backend

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run test:coverage
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run lint && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run lint
scripts.lint:check: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run lint:check && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run lint:check
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run format && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run format:check && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run format:check
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app run type-check && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server run type-check
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter @monorepo/web-app exec rm -rf dist && pnpm --filter @monorepo/api-server exec rm -rf dist
